description: Canonical REJECT corpus for scene_control (ADR 003 Amendment 4 §A4.2 — overlay form). Every payload here MUST be rejected by validate_scene_control; the cut consumer (#72) issues ZERO obs-ws calls and the overlay consumer (#73) renders nothing. `invariant` names which contract guarantee the case proves. `value` is the leaf value unless the case targets the leaf PATH (then `bad_path` is set).

cases.name: leaf-level-path-field-present
cases.reason: a top-level `path` (the superseded free-path media construct) is forbidden — strict schema rejects the unknown key

cases.name: overlay-level-asset_id-present
cases.reason: an `asset_id` inside `overlay` is the old OBS media construct; there is no OBS media in the overlay form — rejected as an unknown overlay key

cases.name: top-level-asset_id-present
cases.reason: a top-level `asset_id` is forbidden — no OBS media asset travels the leaf

cases.name: obs-action-verb-present
cases.reason: the superseded OBS action verb `action: switch_program_scene` must not appear; there is no leaf-carried OBS verb in the overlay form — rejected as an unknown top-level key

cases.name: old-transition-object-present
cases.reason: the old `transition` sub-object (kind:stinger/asset_id/point_ms/duration_ms) is the superseded OBS-native shape and is rejected as an unknown top-level key

cases.name: unknown-top-level-key
cases.reason: any unknown top-level key is rejected (reject-unknown-fields, strict schema, as Bastion validated on the prior contract)

cases.name: unknown-overlay-key
cases.reason: any unknown overlay key is rejected (reject-unknown-fields at the nested level too)

cases.name: target_scene-not-allowlisted
cases.reason: arbitrary scene-name injection into SetCurrentProgramScene must be impossible; off the closed 2-scene set

cases.name: overlay-kind-not-allowlisted
cases.reason: an unauthored / unknown overlay element key must not address Solar's overlay renderer

cases.name: cut-window-violated-too-early
cases.reason: cut_at_ms < reveal_ms: the cut fires before the overlay is fully opaque — the content snap is SEEN. THE visual-safety core (§A4.2)

cases.name: cut-window-violated-too-late
cases.reason: cut_at_ms > reveal_ms+hold_ms: the overlay has begun retracting (transparent again) when the cut fires — the content snap is SEEN

cases.name: cut-window-violated-zero-cut-nonzero-reveal
cases.reason: cut_at_ms=0 while reveal_ms>0: the cut fires at leaf-apply before any opacity — fully visible

cases.name: reveal_ms-out-of-bounds-high
cases.reason: reveal_ms above the 20000 ms ceiling

cases.name: hold_ms-out-of-bounds-low-zero
cases.reason: hold_ms=0 is below the 1 ms floor — a zero-width opaque plateau leaves no cut window

cases.name: cut_at_ms-out-of-bounds-high
cases.reason: cut_at_ms above the 20000 ms ceiling

cases.name: reveal_ms-not-integer-string
cases.reason: timing fields must be integers, not strings

cases.name: cut_at_ms-is-float
cases.reason: cut_at_ms must be a strict int, not a float — no silent truncation of a millisecond offset

cases.name: hold_ms-is-bool
cases.reason: a bool must not coerce to 1 — a timing field is a number, not a flag

cases.name: overlay-missing
cases.reason: overlay sub-object absent — not an object

cases.name: two-segment-leaf-path-F1
cases.reason: the F1 bug: 2-segment __inputs.blue.scene_control is structurally impossible for Blue to write and must be rejected by the consumer's path matcher

cases.name: wrong-port-leaf-path
cases.reason: a 3-segment leaf whose final segment is not scene_control must not be matched as a scene_control leaf

cases.name: dotted-slug-escape-leaf-path
cases.reason: a `.` inside the slug segment would forge a deeper path; Blue's _SEGMENT_RE forbids it and the consumer matcher must too

cases.name: trailing-newline-leaf-path
cases.reason: an otherwise-canonical leaf path with a trailing newline must be rejected; Python's `$` matches before a final `\n`, so the path matcher MUST anchor with `\Z` (this case fails unless the regex rejects the trailing newline)
